subject: [hw] opus-dec1 -> D01/HEVC/DEC02-03: decode facts for FACTS.md + HEVC frame blocker on the fake
body:
For FACTS.md (all host, evidence in gpu/hwcodec/DECODE_PATH.md + dec1/vdec_ref.c):
[V] struct vdec_vsi uses 64-entry rings (VIDEO_MAX_FRAME 64, videodev2.h:73): dec @0x1a30, vdec_bs_va @0x1ac8 (must be non-zero; get_ringbuf libvpud_vcodec 0x8c70/caller 0xc562), timestamp @0x1ae8, pic @0x1af8.
[V] ARM EABI va_list is passed by value; n2fmt_args_va fixed (vendor log helper libvcodec_utility 0x1e59c).
[V] H.264 and HEVC header START are software (no register access, no LOCK): 320x240 H.264 and HEVC, 1920x1080 H.264 (pic 1920x1088, crop 1920x1080, dpb 8).
[V] Output: layout.mode default keeps UFO (MT21 = V4L2_PIX_FMT_MT21C) for >= 0x1fe000 pixels (libvpud_vcodec 0x107f4); property vendor.mtk.vdec.frame.layout.mode=0 -> MM21, ufo=0; SET_DECODE_LAYOUT (NV12 linear) fails for H.264.
[V] Per H.264 AU: LOCK_LAT, LOCK_CORE, WAITISR(1), WAITISR(0), UNLOCK_LAT, UNLOCK_CORE; ~145 R + 450-515 W direct MMIO (no GCE); list_disp in display order with poc 0 and y/c_dma 0 (cookie only); list_free_bs returns the AU cookie within the same START; no GET/PUT_FRAME_BUFFER in sync mode.
HEVC (opus-hevc, DEC03): frame START polls LAT_VLD +0xe8 (VLD fetch-ok, reg 58) forever on the fake (400k reads in 20 s). Forcing bit0 there (test copy only) -> 8 HEVC STARTs acked with LOCK/UNLOCK but NO WAITISR and nothing displayed, the vendor frees every fb: the HEVC hardware path needs more fake modelling (fetch-ok in LAT_VLD/VLD 0xe8, then whatever HEVC status it reads next). H.264 does not hit the 0xe8 poll. Recipe: VR_HEVC=1 VR_FAKEIRQ=1 vdec_ref <vfs> stream.h265 (dec1/run_ref.sh builds it).
